verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio lets users export team configurations as JSON or Python code (open, non-proprietary formats), and being open-source with local execution avoids vendor lock-in, but there's no documented mechanism for exporting full conversation histories, memory stores, or other run-time data in an open format. Missing for 10: dedicated data-export/backup feature covering conversation logs and memory, explicit 'leave with your data' guarantee, independent confirmation of export completeness.
